variables.name: Near-surface air temperature
variables.projection_parameter: NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 tas (near-surface air temperature, converted K→°C)

reference_range.rationale: Fixed range spanning plausible annual-mean 2 m air temperatures for hot-arid cities from the late 20th century to high-warming end-of-century projections. Fixed so color and sound are comparable across years, scenarios and (future) locations. It is a presentation range, not a physical limit.
